messages.subject: Live Data
parts:
I was wondering if it possible to connect live data into shiny. Ie: stock quotes.

I feel that the constant update will make the loading blurry all the time.

Is this possible?

Thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Live Data
parts:
Yes, we are about to merge a function called reactivePoll (tentative name) that will make this relatively straightforward to do. However, it will not be all that appropriate if the call to get stock quotes takes a long time, as it will hold up the R process as the request is being made.

If the call does take a long time, then another way to go would be to have a separate process running that continually looks for and downloads new data, and updates a file on disk. Then the Shiny process simply needs to check the disk for changes periodically and load when changes are detected--the same merge that has reactivePoll will also have reactiveFileReader which implements part of this.
